interface.shortDescription: Run WooCommerce store analytics workflows with Claude-ready MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for WooCommerce for Claude. Use them with a store that has the WooCommerce for Claude WordPress plugin connected over MCP to run weekly reviews, revenue-drop triage, coupon-performance triage, customer value reviews, customer acquisition reviews, inventory risk reviews, catalogue merchandising reviews, product performance reviews, channel performance reviews, geography reviews, shipping-method reviews, payment-method reviews, failed-order triage, refund triage, tax reconciliation, catalogue audits, product content improvements, and store health checks.
